title: Interior and Exterior Angles of Polygons
seo_title: Grade 7 Polygon Angles Worksheets with Answers (MATATAG Math 7)
standard_text: Deduce the relationship between the exterior angle and adjacent interior angle of a polygon; determine the measures of angles and the number of sides of polygons.
meta_desc: Free Grade 7 polygon angles worksheets for the DepEd MATATAG curriculum: angle sums, interior and exterior angles of regular polygons and the number of sides. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Interior + exterior = 180°; exterior angles add to 360°.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A polygon with n sides can be split into n − 2 triangles, so its interior angles add up to (n − 2) × 180°.
  • Each interior angle of a regular polygon is (n − 2) × 180° ÷ n.
  • An interior angle and the exterior angle next to it add up to 180°.
  • The exterior angles of any convex polygon add up to 360°. In a regular polygon each exterior angle is 360° ÷ n.

Examples

Example

Regular octagon

(8 − 2) × 180 = 1,080

1,080 ÷ 8

Answer: 135° each

Example

Exterior angle 24°

360 ÷ 24

Answer: 15 sides

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
n × 180Use (n − 2) × 180.
Dividing by the wrong numberDivide the sum by the number of angles, n.
Interior or exterior?Exterior = 180° − interior.
